params.body:
The office menu ran nine items in one row, with the worksheet app and the pages that look at the company data mixed together.

- **Left of a thin vertical bar:** the worksheet app (Dag, Inzichten, Catalogus, Ploeg, Werf-app, and Demo resetten when the demo switch is on).
- **Right of the bar:** Verkennen and Netwerk. Then the signed-in name and Afmelden, a little further apart.
- **"Werkfiches" next to the logo is gone**, and the browser tab reads "<page> · GLK" instead of "<page> · GLK werkfiches". The sign-in page and the guest layout are unchanged.

Somebody on a shared link still sees only Verkennen and Netwerk.

One file: `resources/views/components/layouts/office.blade.php`. Full suite passes. Checked in a browser.
params.title: Office menu: app left, Verkennen and Netwerk right of a bar
